options: Reconciling loaded totals against legacy source reports
Fixing legacy data issues like duplicates and inconsistent formatting before it is loaded
Writing test scripts for SIT
Signing off the Business Process Design document
questions.explain: Cleansing fixes source data problems — deduplication, standardizing formats, mapping old codes to new ones — before any load file is built.

questions.q: Why is it important that enterprise structure decisions are locked down before serious data migration begins?
options: Because FBDI requires an internet connection
Because it has no real bearing on migration timing
Because Oracle Support requires it as a contractual term
Because cleansing against a target structure that doesn't exist yet is impossible
questions.explain: Cleansing maps old codes to new structures (chart of accounts, business units), which can't happen until those target structures are decided.

questions.q: What does "validation" prove that a successful file load alone does not?
options: That what landed in Oracle Fusion actually ties back to independent legacy source totals
That the FBDI file was formatted correctly
That the Executive Sponsor approved the budget
That the configuration workbook was signed off
questions.explain: A file can load with no errors yet still be incorrect; validation reconciles the loaded data against independent legacy totals to confirm correctness.

questions.q: What is a good outcome when a mock conversion cycle fails validation?
options: It means the project should be cancelled
It means Oracle Fusion is broken and a Service Request must be filed
It means a cleansing rule needs adjusting, caught early rather than during the real cutover
It means the legal entity structure must be redesigned
questions.explain: A failed mock load is a good outcome at this stage because it surfaces a cleansing problem weeks before go-live, when there's time to fix it properly.

questions.q: What problem did Brightfield's first Cash Management mock load surface?
options: Missing legal entity records
Three bank account numbers with a dash format the FBDI template didn't accept
An unapproved Solution Design Document
A missing Executive Sponsor signature
questions.explain: The first mock load failed on three bank account rows due to a dash format issue, which was fixed with a cleansing rule before the second mock load succeeded.
